text:
alex: Thanks for joining today's AH. Dropping a follow-up thread for quick clarifications and owners.
maria: Two asks from the product Qs: 1) Can we get a clearer public statement on which models will be in the curated catalog at GA? 2) What's the migration path for customers who want to move from hosted to Dedicated?
kevin: For curated models: we'll publish a list of model families + compatibility notes by next week. I'll own the doc.
jade: Migration path: we have a checklist draft (network, auth, traffic cutover) that I'll turn into a customer playbook. Will need input from infra on IP allowlists.
sam: Pricing follow-up: do we expose token-level cost estimates in the Console before customers hit quota? The deck implied yes but want confirmation.
noah: We do plan to surface an estimated token cost per-request in the Console beta. Ops team to confirm exact fields. Noah -> creating INF-3522.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Slides/audio + raw Q&A export -> https://redwood.example.com/ah/2026-03-23/export.json
maria: Small security note from the chat: can private deployments restrict outbound telemetry by default?
kevin: Default will be deny; customers can opt-in via config. I'll add this to the Private docs.
jade: Action items I captured:
- Curated model list for GA: kevin (owner) - due 2026-03-30
- Hosted->Dedicated migration playbook: jade + eng-infra - draft 2026-04-06
- Console per-request cost estimate fields: noah + ops - INF-3522 - due 2026-04-02
- Private telemetry default: kevin - update docs 2026-04-09
alex: Two addons: 1) please tag any AH-derived roadmap cards with label AH-Q. 2) If you want to be named as an owner on any item above, reply to this thread. I'll compile the RFC links tomorrow AM.
sam: Adding a note: would love an example webhook payload for billing alerts to drop into our demo app. Noah, can you add that to INF-3522?
noah: Yep will include a sample payload + schema.
alex: Thanks all 44d. If anything missing, ping me here and I'll update the owner list.
